EXTRACTION DONE + PUSHED: Gerrit change 1364 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1364), commit 50da660b97.

- New module src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/peer_state.py: 135 LOC (>=100 floor met) — _BASELINE_FIELDS + get_baseline/set_baseline/get_peer_parent/set_peer_parent/seed_baselines_from_snapshot as free functions over the bindings dict, bodies moved verbatim (only self._data['bindings'] -> bindings param).
- binding_store.py: 794 -> 699 LOC (<700 AC met). BindingStore keeps thin delegates; public surface unchanged — no call site or test double edited. Module docstring condensed for headroom (same practice as change 1296, recorded in this ticket's description).
- New tests tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_peer_state.py (13 tests) exercise peer_state directly WITHOUT a BindingStore, pinning: absent baseline -> None (local-wins), absent peer parent -> None (NO clear), plus 'observed to have none' still reads None, filtering to _BASELINE_FIELDS, copy semantics, unbound no-ops, seed counting.

VALIDATION: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler 2189 passed / 1 failed — the failure (state/test_ref_lock.py::test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote) fails IDENTICALLY on the pristine main checkout at origin/main, i.e. pre-existing/environmental, unrelated to this change. tests/integration/rebar_reconciler: 36 passed. Existing baseline suites (test_binding_baseline.py 29 tests) pass untouched. make lint: all checks passed. make typecheck (mypy 429 files): no issues. Module-size contract test passes; wc -l: binding_store 699, peer_state 135.

Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 on change 1364.
